boundary: High would clearly be right if the extract held stronger identifiers (ID numbers, financial or health data) or covered several people; with one person's name, birth date and address to one contractor, Moderate is defensible.
factor: single third party's civil-register PII to one external contractor
note: Assessor stated all facts that matter; the disagreement is whether name+DOB+address of one person to one external contractor counts as a sensitive target (High) or a limited-scope disclosure (Moderate).
